# edge-wire-plan-correction

Provider: Codex.
Provider version: unknown; shape observed or permitted, not version-exclusive.
Source class: constructed example.

Completed plan is authoritative by schema, even when it differs from delta concatenation. Current adapter ignores plan delta but accepts the completed raw item with an unclassified category.

Expected output is a research oracle for the proposed standard, not current Nano output. IDs beginning `item-` are fixture-local logical IDs. Nulls mean no evidence. Captured arrays may be reduced to four entries; prose, paths, and identities are neutralized.
